about: Map v2 art (windows, interior floors, furniture and cover, decor, ground variants). Same schema as art/sprites.json, so scripts/gen-sprites.mjs runs it unchanged from a work dir whose art/sprites.json points here (see 'run'). Raw 1024 px generations live in art/raw/map-v2/, game-ready PNGs in apps/web/public/sprites/. Tiles are not taken from the plain resize: 'post' says how each was made to repeat from the raw (crop = cut an exact period box through the middle of grout/plank/slab lines; seamcut = per axis, the raw is merged with its half-rolled copy along a minimum-error cut path in 25 % edge bands, so pebbles and tufts are never ghosted), then Lanczos to 256. 'derived' sprites are made from a keyed generated one, not generated. Contact sheet: docs/map-v2-art.png.
run: work dir W: W/art/sprites.json -> art/map-v2.json, W/art/raw -> art/raw/map-v2, W/art/style-test -> art/style-test, W/scripts -> scripts, W/.env -> .env, W/art/sprites = output; then `node scripts/gen-sprites.mjs <id>` in W, two ids at a time.
style: Game sprite in exactly the art style of the reference image (bright stylized cartoon like ZombsRoyale, flat colors, soft shading, thick dark outlines, chunky readable shapes).
view: Seen STRICTLY from directly above (bird's-eye, 90 degrees top-down, NOT 3/4 or isometric view).
isolate: Centered, single isolated object filling about 70% of the frame, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta background (#FF00FF), no gradient, no ground texture, no cast shadow, no text, no letters, no logos. Do not use any pink, magenta or purple colors on the object.
tile: Seamless tileable square ground texture filling the whole frame edge to edge, top-down, no objects, no text.
